checks: Every real image decodes with expected dimensions and reference pixel; all pinned tabs remain.
Split groups and expanded dialog share one resource; closing one consumer preserves the image.
Actual same-size/restored-mtime write and restoration update decoded pixels.
Hiding files releases the URL, keeps all tab metadata, and returning decodes again.
Corrupt images show a local error; Retry reads again and a later real write recovers.
JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, ICO, AVIF and SVG decode; SVG source-mode undo/redo and unsaved text across preview are verified. History across editor unmount is outside this check.
Oversized raster shows the limit and never requests its body.
Real renderer reload restores every pinned tab but loads only the visible raster payload.
optimized.scope: Linux source Electron, private profile and real local images. DOM-ready and decoded pixels, not paint timing. Diagnostic GC only when explicitly configured; later natural snapshots in that cohort follow earlier diagnostic collections. Complete process-tree PSS only; native browser caches remain included. No external model or GPU-driver memory claim.

geometry.scope: Settled image geometry and screenshot; not latency or memory measurement. Source center pixel is recorded, no exact scaled-screen pixel equality is implied.

scope: Three alternating fresh app pairs per cohort; unforced and diagnostic-retained observations are separate fresh processes. Same fixtures/size/profile seed and dependency installation. Baseline and optimized compiled UIs differ only through source changes; hashes are recorded, never attributed solely to one module. PSS is accepted only for complete process-tree observations. No physical-device, model-memory or continuous peak/GC pause claim.
